LK.title: Sri Lanka
LK.scope: Five crops have reviewed local traits. Rotation rules apply in a grower-confirmed lowland dry or intermediate zone.

sources.title: Department of Agriculture, Kilinochchi crop guidance

IN.title: India
IN.scope: ICAR district contingency plans include local crop and season information. District and cultivar rules await review.

sources.title: ICAR, Kharif contingency planning for Andhra Pradesh

KE.title: Kenya
KE.scope: KALRO publishes crop-specific production guidance. County and variety rules await review.

BR.title: Brazil
BR.scope: ZARC publishes climate-risk zoning by crop and location. Municipality, soil, cycle and season must be matched.

US.title: United States
US.scope: USDA publishes usual planting and harvest dates by state and crop. A state calendar does not establish a field rotation.

sources.title: USDA NASS, usual planting and harvesting dates

AU.title: Australia
AU.scope: NSW publishes variety-specific sowing information. Guidance requires a matching district and variety.

sources.title: NSW Department of Primary Industries, sowing and seeding
